verdict.rationale: First-party material says Claude Code lets developers 'build, debug, and ship' through natural-language commands. Supporting claims include debugging live web apps via Chrome, piping logs into it, overnight CI failure analysis, and turning a Slack bug report into a pull request. Missing for 10: a dedicated, in-depth debugging/troubleshooting workflow doc (the evidence is mostly one-line overview and marketing claims), and independent hands-on corroboration of debugging quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: Work with Claude directly in your codebase. Build, debug, and ship from your terminal, IDE, Slack, web, and more.
helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows -- all through natural language commands
Pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain it with other tools
mention @Claude in Slack with a bug report and get a pull request back
